opening.text: Boulder in gold, Zip in teal. The Rush Arena rivals are off!

next.text: A fresh scoreline, a fresh chance. Here we go again!

halfTime.text: That's halftime. The teams swap ends, and the score carries over.

halfFeature.text: Half time! Take another look at one of my favorite moments.

secondHalf.text: The teams are back in motion. Second half underway!

finalWin.text: There's the final whistle! One more match coming right up.

finalDraw.text: All square at full time. They'll get another shot in the next match!

goalOne.text: It's in! Listen to that crowd!

goalTwo.text: There it is! That one found the back of the net!

goalThree.text: What a finish! The keeper had a lot to cover there.

equalizer.text: We're level again! This match just came to life.

ownGoal.text: Oh, that's an own goal. A tough bounce for the defending side.

saveOne.text: What a stop! The keeper had to move fast for that one.

saveTwo.text: The keeper gets there in time! Play goes on.

post.text: Off the frame of the goal! Everybody's chasing the rebound.

shotOne.text: They've had a go! Keep an eye on the ball.

shotTwo.text: There's the shot. The keeper is tracking it.

intercept.text: Read the pass perfectly. Here's a chance to break the other way.

tackle.text: Clean challenge! They're going the other way now.

pass.text: Quick passing opens up space. Watch the runners off the ball.

distribution.text: The keeper gets it moving again. The team spreads out to receive.

lastMinute.text: One minute left in this match. There's still time for one more chance!

lastMinuteLevel.text: One minute left and they're still level. Who's got one more trick?

oneGoalLeft.text: One goal between them with a minute left. Nobody can relax yet.

openingDuel.text: Boulder loves a big finish. Zip likes to leave you guessing.

boulderShot.text: Boulder winds up. Here comes the big swing!

zipShot.text: Zip found a gap! Quick turn, quick shot.

boulderGoal.text: Boulder scores! And there's his grand little bow.

zipGoal.text: Zip slips it in! He makes that look like a magic trick.

boulderPayback.text: Boulder remembers the last save. This time his bow is right on cue!

zipPayback.text: The keeper stopped Zip earlier. This time the trick worked!

boulderStretch.text: Boulder started celebrating. Now he's pretending it was a stretch.

zipHeadsUp.text: That nearly fooled the keeper. Zip's grin just went sideways.

mittsSave.text: Mitts gets to it! Those big gloves had the last word.

patchSave.text: Patch shuts the door! No way through that time.

mittsAgain.text: Mitts has seen that trick before. Same answer from those gloves.

patchAgain.text: Patch wins that little rematch. The shot looked good for a second.

boulderPost.text: Boulder, meet the post. I think it just said hello back.

zipPost.text: Zip gives the post a second look. Yes, Zip, it's still there.

postSecond.text: Off the post. The ball is back in play!

zipSteals.text: Zip nicks it away! Look how quickly play turns around.

boulderSteals.text: Boulder spotted the chance and took it. Nice clean steal.

tradeSteals.text: There goes the ball the other way again. These two keep trading tricks.

boulderFooled.text: Boulder's checking his feet. The ball has already gone!

zipFooled.text: For once, Zip is the one looking around for the ball.

lateGoal.text: That's a huge goal this late in the match!

lateEqualizer.text: And they're level with the clock running down! What a finish.

leadChange.text: They've turned it around and taken the lead!

saveBreak.text: No goal there. That save deserves a cheer of its own.

woodworkBreak.text: That was so close. The post had other plans.

quietBuild.text: Look at the players out wide. They're trying to make a gap.

scruffRecap.text: Zip is Scruff's captain. See the mint scarf? He's always looking for a trick.

roundhouseRecap.text: That's Boulder in the orange headband. He's the Roundhouse captain.

zipMittsRecap.text: Corner of your eye on Zip and Mitts. They've already tested each other this match.

boulderPatchRecap.text: Boulder and Patch have already faced off. Let's see who wins the next one.

saveReplay.text: Look at the keeper here. Watch those gloves on the replay.

postReplay.text: Watch this bounce. The post had a big say in that play.

stealReplay.text: Watch how fast they turn this steal into a run.

backInIt.text: They've pulled one back. Now there's something to chase.

openingAlt1.text: Welcome to Rush Arena! Gold and teal, let's play!

openingAlt2.text: Ready, rivals? Ready, fans? It's kickoff time!

openingAlt3.text: Boots tied? Gloves on? Here come the Rush Arena rivals!

nextAlt1.text: Fresh match! Everybody gets another go.

nextAlt2.text: New whistle, clean scoreboard. Let the next round begin!

nextAlt3.text: Reset the score and wake up those football boots!

halfTimeAlt1.text: Time for a breather! They'll switch ends and keep that score.

halfTimeAlt2.text: Half time! Even the football gets a little rest.

halfTimeAlt3.text: That's the break. Same score, new ends when we return.

halfFeatureAlt1.text: Half time! Here's one play worth a second peek.

halfFeatureAlt2.text: Freeze those boots. We've got a replay to watch!

halfFeatureAlt3.text: Before they swap ends, let's watch that moment again.

secondHalfAlt1.text: Back on the pitch! The second half is rolling.

secondHalfAlt2.text: Gloves up, boots ready. Here comes half number two!

secondHalfAlt3.text: They're playing toward the other ends now. Away we go!

finalWinAlt1.text: That's the final whistle! See the winning side celebrate.

finalWinAlt2.text: Boots down! We have a winner at Rush Arena.

finalWinAlt3.text: Game over! A new match is just around the corner.

finalDrawAlt1.text: Same score on both sides! They'll settle it another time.

finalDrawAlt2.text: The whistle says that's a tie. Both teams get a cheer!

finalDrawAlt3.text: All level at the end. Who knew one football could cause such fuss?

goalOneAlt1.text: Goal! That net just did a little dance!

goalOneAlt2.text: It's in! Save room for the celebration!

goalOneAlt3.text: Goal! The ball is in and the crowd is up!

goalOneAlt4.text: Boom! That one's worth a wiggle!

goalTwoAlt1.text: In it goes! Wave those flags!

goalTwoAlt2.text: That's a goal! Look at those happy boots!

goalTwoAlt3.text: The ball hits the net. Here comes the happy dance!

goalThreeAlt1.text: What a finish! The net couldn't keep still.

goalThreeAlt2.text: That one's in! No wonder the stand is bouncing.

goalThreeAlt3.text: Goal! Look at that team light up!

equalizerAlt1.text: Goal, and we're level! It's anybody's match again.

equalizerAlt2.text: The scoreboard just matched its socks. We're all square!

equalizerAlt3.text: Same score on both sides! Who'll pull ahead now?

lateEqualizerAlt1.text: Just in time! That goal makes it a tie again.

lateEqualizerAlt2.text: Level, with time running out! What a twist!

lateEqualizerAlt3.text: Right at the end, they pull level! Hold on to your hats!

lateGoalAlt1.text: Late goal! They saved a surprise for the end!

lateGoalAlt2.text: Time's nearly up, and in it goes!

lateGoalAlt3.text: There's a goal right near the finish! What a twist!

leadChangeAlt1.text: New leader! The scoreboard has flipped!

leadChangeAlt2.text: In it goes, and now they're in front!

leadChangeAlt3.text: One more goal, and the lead changes sides!

backInItAlt1.text: They get one back! We have a chase on our hands.

backInItAlt2.text: One back on the board! This match has more in store.

backInItAlt3.text: That's a goal back! They're still in this.

ownGoalAlt1.text: Oh crumbs! That bounce took it into their own net.

ownGoalAlt2.text: Oops, wrong net. Shake it off and go again!

ownGoalAlt3.text: An own goal! Sometimes the ball writes its own jokes.

boulderGoalAlt1.text: Boulder scores! Make room for that big bow!

boulderGoalAlt2.text: Big kick, big goal! Take your bow, Boulder.

zipGoalAlt1.text: Zip scores! Turn that scarf into a victory flag!

zipGoalAlt2.text: Ta-da! Zip's trick ends up in the net!

mittsGoal.text: Mitts scores! A goal from the keeper!

mittsGoalAlt1.text: The keeper gets a goal of his own! Way to go, Mitts!

pipGoal.text: Pip scores! The goggles found a way!

pipGoalAlt1.text: Goal for Pip! That was a puzzle with a very loud answer.

sunnyGoal.text: Sunny scores! That flower's going to bounce!

sunnyGoalAlt1.text: Goal for Sunny! The whole stand just brightened up.

doodleGoal.text: Doodle scores! Put a big circle around that one.

doodleGoalAlt1.text: Doodle adds a little dot to the scoreboard. It's a goal!

patchGoal.text: Patch scores! The keeper can finish too!

patchGoalAlt1.text: Patch puts it in! Somebody tell those gloves!

crankGoal.text: Goal for Crank! The Wall can score too!

crankGoalAlt1.text: Crank scores! Even those ear pads heard that cheer.

dashGoal.text: Dash gets the goal! Now see if the shoes can stop!

dashGoalAlt1.text: Dash scores! Even the quiff is celebrating!

tangleGoal.text: Tangle works it out! That one's in the net!

tangleGoalAlt1.text: Goal for Tangle! Tie a bow around that finish!

postAlt1.text: Clang! The goal frame sends it back!

postAlt2.text: That hit the frame! The ball's still out there.

postAlt3.text: Off the woodwork! The ball took a noisy detour.

postAlt4.text: The goal frame says no. Watch the bounce!

woodworkBreakAlt1.text: Ping! So close. Even the post sounded surprised.

woodworkBreakAlt2.text: The frame had a vote, and the vote was clang!

woodworkBreakAlt3.text: Oh, that rattle! The net is still waiting.

saveOneAlt1.text: What a save! Those gloves earned a cheer.

saveOneAlt2.text: The keeper is there! That ball had somewhere else in mind.

saveOneAlt3.text: Stopped! Give the keeper a little glove clap.

saveTwoAlt1.text: No way through on that shot! The keeper read it.

saveTwoAlt2.text: Save! The keeper gets the last word again.

saveTwoAlt3.text: That shot was looking dangerous. Then came the keeper!

diveSave.text: Full stretch! What a diving save!

diveSaveAlt1.text: The keeper takes off sideways and makes the stop!

diveSaveAlt2.text: Gloves out, feet off the grass. Diving save!

diveSaveAlt3.text: That dive looked like a leap across a puddle!

tipSave.text: A fingertip save! Just enough glove on it.

tipSaveAlt1.text: What a touch! The keeper gets a fingertip there.

tipSaveAlt2.text: Tip! One little touch makes a big difference.

tipSaveAlt3.text: The keeper stretches high and changes the ball's mind!

scoopSave.text: Down low! The keeper makes the scoop.

scoopSaveAlt1.text: The keeper gets low and scoops that shot away.

scoopSaveAlt2.text: A little dip, a big save! Look how low the keeper gets.

scoopSaveAlt3.text: Quick gloves near the grass. Well scooped!

blockSave.text: Big block! The keeper gets right behind that shot.

blockSaveAlt1.text: Save! The keeper makes a wall of gloves and boots.

blockSaveAlt2.text: The keeper spreads out and blocks the way!

blockSaveAlt3.text: That shot met a whole keeper in its path.

heldSave.text: Safe in the gloves! That ball can stop wiggling now.

heldSaveAlt1.text: Held tight! The keeper keeps it under control.

heldSaveAlt2.text: The keeper hangs on! A good moment for a deep breath.

heldSaveAlt3.text: Two gloves around it. Safe and sound!

shotOneAlt1.text: Here comes a shot! Keep your eyes on the ball.

shotOneAlt2.text: A swing and a shot! Where's it headed?

shotOneAlt3.text: Boot meets ball! That one's on its way.

shotTwoAlt1.text: There's the strike! Will the keeper get there?

shotTwoAlt2.text: They've had a shot. Watch the keeper now!

shotTwoAlt3.text: Someone fancied a shot. Let's follow it!

boulderShotAlt1.text: Boulder shoots! I think the boot woke up first.

boulderShotAlt2.text: Big swing from Boulder! Watch where it goes.

zipShotAlt1.text: Zip takes a shot! He kept that one up his sleeve.

zipShotAlt2.text: Zip shoots! Blink after the ball lands.

longShot.text: A shot from way out! That's a long ride for the ball.

longShotAlt1.text: They've tried one from distance! Look at it go.

longShotAlt2.text: That's a long-range shot. Is the keeper ready?

longShotAlt3.text: Wallop! A shot from out there needs a real swing!

loftPass.text: Up it goes! A little holiday for the football.

loftPassAlt1.text: Lofted pass! Find the runner under that ball.

loftPassAlt2.text: That pass went upstairs. Watch where it comes down.

loftPassAlt3.text: High pass! There's a teammate chasing it.

switchPass.text: Over to the other wing! That's a big switch.

switchPassAlt1.text: The ball is crossing the pitch. Look for the far-side runner.

switchPassAlt2.text: A switch of play! Everyone has to turn their heads.

switchPassAlt3.text: Way across it goes! The other side of the pitch just woke up.

drivePass.text: Zing! That's a firm pass into space.

drivePassAlt1.text: Driven pass! See who can meet it.

drivePassAlt2.text: A quick low ball! The runner has to get there.

passAlt1.text: Little passes, little gaps. Watch the space open up.

passAlt2.text: Watch the teammate moving for the next pass.

passAlt3.text: A pass to keep things moving. Where's the next gap?

interceptAlt1.text: Cut out the pass! Good reading of the play.

interceptAlt2.text: Wrong address! That pass found a rival.

interceptAlt3.text: The defender stepped in early and picked it off.

tackleAlt1.text: Good challenge! The ball changes feet.

tackleAlt2.text: A quick poke and it's theirs. Neat tackle!

tackleAlt3.text: Tackle won! Now the other side gets a turn.

distributionAlt1.text: The keeper starts the next move. Look for a teammate out wide.

distributionAlt2.text: Out it goes from the keeper! The team can build again.

distributionAlt3.text: The keeper sends it on its way. Here comes the next play.

lastMinuteAlt1.text: One minute to go! Let's see who has a final surprise.

lastMinuteAlt2.text: We're into the last minute. Keep those boots moving!

lastMinuteAlt3.text: Sixty seconds left. One more chance, maybe?

lastMinuteLevelAlt1.text: One minute left, still level. This could go either way!

lastMinuteLevelAlt2.text: All square with sixty seconds to play. Who's got a last trick?

lastMinuteLevelAlt3.text: The score is tied and the clock is ticking. One minute!

oneGoalLeftAlt1.text: One goal the difference, one minute on the clock!

oneGoalLeftAlt2.text: Sixty seconds left and only one goal in it. Hang on!

oneGoalLeftAlt3.text: One minute to go. The next goal could change everything.

saveReplayAlt1.text: Watch the keeper again. Look at the timing on that stop.

saveReplayAlt2.text: Here comes the replay! Keep your eyes on those gloves.

saveReplayAlt3.text: Back it up a little. That save is worth seeing twice.

postReplayAlt1.text: Watch the goal frame on this replay. Here comes the clang!

postReplayAlt2.text: Here's that rebound again. See where the ball bounces!

postReplayAlt3.text: A second peek at the moment the goal frame joined in.

stealReplayAlt1.text: Watch the defender step in on this replay.

stealReplayAlt2.text: How did the ball change teams so fast? Take another look.

stealReplayAlt3.text: Here's the steal again. Follow the player who steps across.

openingAlt4.text: Ready, little football detectives? Pick a kit. Find the ball!

openingAlt5.text: Gold shirts, teal shirts, one very bouncy football!

openingAlt6.text: Spot Boulder in gold and Zip in teal. Who gets there first?

openingAlt7.text: Look for the blue helmet and the pink patch. Those are our keepers!

openingAlt8.text: The ball has one job. Everyone else has ten ideas!

nextAlt4.text: New whistle, fresh score. Who gets the first dance this time?

nextAlt5.text: Back to the middle. Shiny new match, same wiggly boots!

nextAlt6.text: Round again! See if you can spot your hero before the kick.

halfTimeAlt4.text: Hands off the football. It's snack time for the boots!

halfTimeAlt5.text: Time for a breath. The teams swap ends and keep their goals.

halfTimeAlt6.text: Half time! Even the goalposts are taking a little break.

secondHalfAlt4.text: Gold and teal swap ends. Follow the ball, here we go!

secondHalfAlt5.text: Whistle up! Same score, other goals, more wiggly feet.

secondHalfAlt6.text: Break's over. Who has the next surprise in their boots?

finalWinAlt4.text: Final whistle! Look for the winning team's biggest wave.

finalWinAlt5.text: Boots down! There's the winning side, waving to the stands.

finalWinAlt6.text: Time's up. One last cheer for both teams!

finalDrawAlt4.text: It's a tie! The scoreboard gave both teams the same number.

finalDrawAlt5.text: Nobody pulls ahead. Two teams, one very busy football.

finalDrawAlt6.text: Look at that. They finish side by side on the scoreboard!

goalOneAlt5.text: Goal goes in! Release the happy feet!

goalOneAlt6.text: Thump, swish, goal! That net got a surprise.

goalOneAlt7.text: In the net! Who's got the best victory wiggle?

goalOneAlt8.text: Goal! Those boots are about to break into a dance.

goalOneAlt9.text: Bing! One more on the scoreboard!

goalTwoAlt4.text: It's in! I heard the net say thank you.

goalTwoAlt5.text: The ball found a pocket in the net!

goalTwoAlt6.text: Goal! Watch what the scorer does next.

goalThreeAlt4.text: Goal! That ball just took a bow.

goalThreeAlt5.text: Up goes the score. Up go the happy arms!

goalThreeAlt6.text: The net wiggles. The crowd wiggles. That's a goal!

ownGoalAlt4.text: Wrong net! Shake those boots and try again.

ownGoalAlt5.text: Oh noodles! That bounce went into their own goal.

ownGoalAlt6.text: The ball got turned around. That's an own goal!

ownGoalAlt7.text: Oops! Wrong goal! There'll be another kick in a moment.

equalizerAlt4.text: Same score! Both teams are back on the same step.

equalizerAlt5.text: A goal ties it up. Who's got another surprise?

equalizerAlt6.text: The scoreboard is all lined up again. We're level!

lateEqualizerAlt4.text: One last twist! They're level with hardly any time left.

lateEqualizerAlt5.text: Back to a tie. Those boots saved a surprise!

lateEqualizerAlt6.text: Goal! They're tied again, just before the whistle.

leadChangeAlt4.text: Boing! The lead has hopped to the other side!

leadChangeAlt5.text: From chasing to leading. What a turn!

leadChangeAlt6.text: There's a new leader. Keep an eye on that scoreboard!

backInItAlt4.text: One goal back. There's still a race here!

backInItAlt5.text: They've closed the gap. Can they find another?

backInItAlt6.text: One back! The team behind has a little more bounce now.

postAlt5.text: Clink! The post got a turn with the ball.

postAlt6.text: Goodness, that frame's loud! Watch the rebound.

postAlt7.text: The post says ping. The ball says I'm still here!

diveSaveAlt4.text: Flip to the side, gloves out! What a save!

diveSaveAlt5.text: There's a flying keeper in the goalmouth!

diveSaveAlt6.text: The keeper turned sideways in midair. What a stop!

tipSaveAlt4.text: One little tap from a very big glove!

tipSaveAlt5.text: Look at the reach. The ball gets a fingertip hello!

tipSaveAlt6.text: Up go the gloves! That tiny touch changes the shot.

scoopSaveAlt4.text: Down to the grass! The keeper scoops it away.

scoopSaveAlt5.text: That ball tried to sneak low. The gloves found it.

scoopSaveAlt6.text: Gloves to the ground. A scoop saves the day!

blockSaveAlt4.text: Wide arms, wide boots. The keeper closes the gap!

blockSaveAlt5.text: Bonk! That shot bumped into a whole keeper.

blockSaveAlt6.text: The keeper spreads out like a star and stops it!

heldSaveAlt4.text: The keeper has it! That ball is taking a glove nap.

heldSaveAlt5.text: Two gloves shut the door. Safe catch!

heldSaveAlt6.text: Got it and kept it! Watch where the keeper sends it next.

loftPassAlt4.text: Upstairs goes the ball! Who can find it first?

loftPassAlt5.text: The football took the elevator. Look for the runner below!

loftPassAlt6.text: Up and over. Watch where that pass comes down.

switchPassAlt4.text: Everyone turn your heads. That pass is crossing the pitch!

switchPassAlt5.text: From this wing to that wing. See who runs to meet it!

switchPassAlt6.text: Whoosh across! Follow the ball to the other side.

longShotAlt4.text: Long shot! The ball has a lot of grass to cross.

longShotAlt5.text: A swing from way back there. Keep watching the keeper!

longShotAlt6.text: That's a big kick from far out. Where's it going?

lastMinuteAlt4.text: One minute left. Can the football fit in one more surprise?

lastMinuteAlt5.text: Final minute! One more dash, one more chance.

lastMinuteAlt6.text: Watch that clock. There's a minute left to play!

lastMinuteLevelAlt4.text: One minute and the same score! Who can untie it?

lastMinuteLevelAlt5.text: Level in the final minute. Hold on to your socks!

lastMinuteLevelAlt6.text: Same number on each side, one minute to change it!

oneGoalLeftAlt4.text: One goal apart, one minute left. Watch those boots!

oneGoalLeftAlt5.text: One minute to find one more. What a chase!

oneGoalLeftAlt6.text: There's one goal in it. Can the team behind catch up?

openingBooth.text: Jom to scoreboard. Can you count to zero?

openingBoothReply.text: Twice, Jom. A fresh match starts at zero each.

openingBoothAlt1.text: I put the football in charge of the next match.

openingBoothReplyAlt1.text: The football says just kick me, please.

openingBoothAlt2.text: Got my lucky microphone ready. Have you?

openingBoothReplyAlt2.text: Yes. Mine is cheering for both sets of boots.

openingBoothAlt3.text: Ring the bell! It's another round of football!

openingBoothReplyAlt3.text: That's a whistle, Jom. But yes, here we go!

postBooth.text: Ping! Was that the bell for snacks?

postBoothReply.text: Goalpost, Jom. Snacks are still at half time.

postBoothAlt1.text: The post would like to join a team.

postBoothReplyAlt1.text: It'll have to learn to move its feet first.

postBoothAlt2.text: Did the goal frame just say hello?

postBoothReplyAlt2.text: It said bonk. Keep watching that rebound.

postBoothAlt3.text: One point for noise. Did you hear that?

postBoothReplyAlt3.text: Only goals count, Jom. Very good clang, though.

saveBooth.text: Can the gloves get a cheer of their own?

saveBoothReply.text: Yes! Even my bells are cheering!

saveBoothAlt1.text: I think the keeper's gloves just said nope.

saveBoothReplyAlt1.text: They're very polite gloves. They said nope, thank you.

saveBoothAlt2.text: The ball was looking for a way past.

saveBoothReplyAlt2.text: It found the keeper. Those gloves were ready!

saveBoothAlt3.text: Do those gloves have tiny springs in them?

saveBoothReplyAlt3.text: That's the keeper's quick hands, Jom.

stealBooth.text: Hey! The ball just changed its travel plans.

stealBoothReply.text: A clean steal. Now the other team gets a turn.

stealBoothAlt1.text: Where'd the ball go? I looked at the wrong boots!

stealBoothReplyAlt1.text: Follow the new runner. They took it clean away.

stealBoothAlt2.text: I was watching the old team, and then snip!

stealBoothReplyAlt2.text: One quick challenge and the ball changed sides.

stealBoothAlt3.text: Did someone swap the football's address?

stealBoothReplyAlt3.text: The defender got there first. That's the new address!

loftBooth.text: The ball's upstairs again. Is there a doorbell?

loftBoothReply.text: Watch the runner underneath. They'll try to meet it.

loftBoothAlt1.text: A high pass! Can it wave to the crowd?

loftBoothReplyAlt1.text: It's got a teammate to find first.

loftBoothAlt2.text: Up it goes. I think I can see the bottom of it!

loftBoothReplyAlt2.text: That's why we call it a loft, Jom.

loftBoothAlt3.text: The ball asked for a little air.

loftBoothReplyAlt3.text: That's a lofted pass. Look for the runner below.

switchBooth.text: The ball wants the other wing. Does it need a map?

switchBoothReply.text: It's a switch, Jom. Follow it across the pitch.

switchBoothAlt1.text: Everyone look over there. No, over there!

switchBoothReplyAlt1.text: A long pass across the pitch. Other side now!

switchBoothAlt2.text: That pass just crossed the whole picture!

switchBoothReplyAlt2.text: A big switch. See who's running on the far side.

switchBoothAlt3.text: I blinked and the ball changed neighborhoods.

switchBoothReplyAlt3.text: It switched wings. Keep up with that runner!

longShotBooth.text: That's a way out! Did the boot pack lunch?

longShotBoothReply.text: Long shot, Jom. Keep an eye on the goal.

longShotBoothAlt1.text: Did they just try a shot from there?

longShotBoothReplyAlt1.text: They did. A long swing, a long way to goal.

longShotBoothAlt2.text: That kick needed a very big windup!

longShotBoothReplyAlt2.text: A long shot. Let's see how the keeper reads it.

longShotBoothAlt3.text: One long shot, coming right up!

longShotBoothReplyAlt3.text: Follow the ball. The keeper has a lot to watch.

boothHello.text: Jom on the mic. Jerry, did the ball just wink at us?

boothHelloReply.text: That was me, whiskers. Watch the kickoff!

boothHelloAlt1.text: Jerry here. Jom, your tail's in my headphones.

boothHelloReplyAlt1.text: Oh! There's my tail. And there's the first touch!

boothHelloAlt2.text: Psst, Jerry. Who gets the first paw on it?

boothHelloReplyAlt2.text: Boot, Jom. See them meet the ball?

boothHelloAlt3.text: I'm Jerry. Jom, where did you hide the whistle?

boothHelloReplyAlt3.text: Behind my ear. Oops, that one's a pencil!

mittsRelease.text: Mitts sends it out! Special delivery from the glove department!

mittsReleaseAlt1.text: Mitts starts the move. Look past those gloves for a gold shirt.

mittsReleaseAlt2.text: Out from Mitts! Football post arrives without a stamp.

mittsReleaseAlt3.text: Watch Mitts after the stop. This pass starts the next adventure.

patchRelease.text: Patch sends the ball out. Which teal shirt sees it first?

patchReleaseAlt1.text: Patch delivers! The glove shop is open for passes.

patchReleaseAlt2.text: From keeper to teammate. Patch gets Scruff moving again.

patchReleaseAlt3.text: Goodbye gloves, hello grass! Patch sends it back out.

pipPass.text: Pip picked a pass! Try saying that before it gets there.

pipPassAlt1.text: See the blue goggles? Pip's found a path for the ball.

pipPassAlt2.text: Pip's puzzle has a round piece. There it goes!

pipPassAlt3.text: Pip sends it on. Follow the ball to the next gold shirt.

sunnyPass.text: Sunny shares it. Look for that pink flower moving on.

sunnyPassAlt1.text: One flower, two boots, and a pass from Sunny!

sunnyPassAlt2.text: Sunny sends the ball along. Who's ready for the next touch?

sunnyPassAlt3.text: That flower can play football! Lovely little pass from Sunny.

doodlePass.text: Doodle just drew a line with a football!

doodlePassAlt1.text: Doodle passes. Trace its path with your eyes.

doodlePassAlt2.text: Doodle's paintbrush has laces today. There's the pass!

doodlePassAlt3.text: The lilac beret gives Doodle away. Watch where that pass goes.

boulderPass.text: Boulder shares the ball. A captain can start a goal, too.

boulderPassAlt1.text: Boulder's big boots have a sharing setting!

boulderPassAlt2.text: Boulder passes it on. Who can use that space?

boulderPassAlt3.text: Roll up for the Boulder delivery service! One ball, coming through.

crankPass.text: Crank lets it go! Even a wall has a mail slot.

crankPassAlt1.text: Crank plays the pass. Watch for those orange ear pads.

crankPassAlt2.text: Click, clack, pass! Crank gets the ball moving.

crankPassAlt3.text: Crank finds a way out. Follow the pass beyond those boots.

dashPass.text: Dash sends it on. Can those speedy feet keep up?

dashPassAlt1.text: Dash passes! Now the ball gets to be the speedy one.

dashPassAlt2.text: See the blue quiff? That's Dash starting this move.

dashPassAlt3.text: The ball just borrowed Dash's running shoes!

tanglePass.text: Tangle untangles the play with one pass!

tanglePassAlt1.text: Follow the yellow bow. Tangle just set the ball free.

tanglePassAlt2.text: Knot in the middle? Tangle has a pass for that!

tanglePassAlt3.text: Tangle gives a teammate a turn. Where's the next bit of space?

zipPass.text: Zip plays the pass. That mint scarf is easy to spot.

zipPassAlt1.text: Zip, zap, pass! That's a scarf with a plan.

zipPassAlt2.text: Zip sends it on. Keep an eye on the next teal shirt.

zipPassAlt3.text: Zip gave the ball a head start! There goes the pass.

boulderStretchAlt1.text: That wasn't a victory dance. Boulder is stretching! Very convincing.

boulderStretchAlt2.text: Patch saved it. Boulder turned the early bow into a stretch.

boulderStretchAlt3.text: One save, one stretch. Excellent timing from Boulder's elbows!

zipWave.text: Zip waves at the keeper. That save deserves a hello.

zipWaveAlt1.text: Zip's shot got stopped. The wave got through!

zipWaveAlt2.text: Look at Zip waving! The keeper takes this round.

boulderShrug.text: Saved! Boulder's shoulders are asking where that ball went.

boulderShrugAlt1.text: Watch Boulder's shrug. Even a good shot can meet a better save.

boulderShrugAlt2.text: Boulder has an answer for those gloves. A very big shrug!

zipPostAlt1.text: Zip, that post can play one note. You just found it.

zipPostAlt2.text: Ping! Zip has turned the goal into a musical instrument.

boulderPostAlt1.text: Boulder rang the post. Nobody's answering the door!

boulderPostAlt2.text: So close, Boulder! Watch where the ball goes after that ping.

mittsAgainAlt1.text: Mitts wins the rematch! I think those gloves remember that boot.

mittsAgainAlt2.text: Same two rivals, another save for Mitts. Watch them reset.

patchAgainAlt1.text: Another stop for Patch against the same shooter. Gloves win this round!

patchAgainAlt2.text: Patch has met those boots before. Hello again, football!

backInItAlt7.text: One back! Somebody wind up the chasing music!

backInItAlt8.text: Count the gap again. That goal brings the teams closer.

halfTimeAlt7.text: Ten minutes down. The teams trade ends and keep their goals.

halfTimeAlt8.text: Halftime. Time to untangle my tail from this chair.

finalDrawAlt7.text: Final whistle. Count both sides! The same number for each.

finalDrawAlt8.text: A tie! One paw up for each team.

finalWinAlt7.text: Final whistle! The winners have the floor for their victory dance.

finalWinAlt8.text: That's the match. Watch the team with the winning score celebrate.

ownGoalAlt8.text: Whoops, wrong net. Even a bouncy ball has a muddled moment.

ownGoalAlt9.text: It went into their own goal. Take a breath. There's a fresh kickoff.

lastMinuteLevelAlt7.text: A minute left! Count the goals. Same number, both teams.

lastMinuteLevelAlt8.text: Level with a minute to go. Even my whiskers are listening.

oneGoalLeftAlt7.text: One minute, one goal between them. Even my microphone is leaning in!

oneGoalLeftAlt8.text: One goal separates them. What could one smart pass do?

diveSaveAlt7.text: That keeper just flew sideways! Where are the wings?

diveSaveAlt8.text: Watch the stretch on that dive. The gloves arrive just in time.

tipSaveAlt7.text: Did you spot the tiny touch? A fingertip changed that shot.

tipSaveAlt8.text: Just the glove tips! Even the keeper's fingers get a highlight.

quietBuildAlt1.text: Follow a player without the ball. Who has room to run?

quietBuildAlt2.text: All those boots, one football. Where's the empty patch?

shotOneAlt4.text: Shot away! My ears went up with that one.

shotOneAlt5.text: Watch the keeper now. Here comes the shot.

shotTwoAlt4.text: A try at goal! Where can the keeper reach?

shotTwoAlt5.text: Boot meets ball! Hang onto your headphones, Jerry.

distributionAlt4.text: Out it comes! Which shirt will open the keeper's parcel?

distributionAlt5.text: The keeper starts a new move. Look for a teammate in space.

goalOneAlt10.text: Goal! My tail just waved at the ceiling!

goalOneAlt11.text: That's over the line! Count one more on the scoreboard.

goalTwoAlt7.text: In it goes! Watch the scorer find the rest of the team.

goalTwoAlt8.text: Goal! Did the net just give that football a hug?

goalThreeAlt7.text: In the net! My microphone wants to do the victory dance!

goalThreeAlt8.text: They scored! Can you spot the scorer in that celebration?

missWide.text: Just wide! Did it sneak past the post, Jerry?

missWideReply.text: Outside the post, Jom. The score stays put.

missWideAlt1.text: My whiskers twitched. Did that one count?

missWideReplyAlt1.text: Wide of the post. Good eyes, whiskers!

missHigh.text: Up and over! Did that touch the roof, Jerry?

missHighReply.text: It cleared the bar, Jom. No goal this time.

missHighAlt1.text: Jom, look up! That ball sailed over the bar.

missHighReplyAlt1.text: I see it. The score stays right there.

sideOut.text: The whole ball crossed the sideline, Jerry.

sideOutReply.text: Two paws ready. Here comes a throw-in.

sideOutAlt1.text: Out by the sideline. Are your paws ready, Jom?

sideOutReplyAlt1.text: Mine are holding this microphone. The players can throw!

keeperReturn.text: A throw from the keeper, Jerry. Where's it headed?

keeperReturnReply.text: Back into play, Jom. Follow that ball!

cornerReturn.text: A throw from the corner, Jom! Did you see it go?

cornerReturnReply.text: Over the head and back onto the pitch!

netAnswerCat.text: I saw it cross, Jerry. All the way in!

netAnswerCatAlt1.text: The net caught it! Even my tail is cheering.

netAnswerCatAlt2.text: A point on the board. Give those paws a clap!

netAnswerMouse.text: One for the scoreboard, Jom. Count it!

netAnswerMouseAlt1.text: Right past the line! Look at those scarves go.

netAnswerMouseAlt2.text: It went all the way in. That's our signal to cheer!

levelAnswerCat.text: All square again. Nobody's ahead, Jerry.

levelAnswerMouse.text: That's a tie, Jom. Both teams are in this!

ownAnswerCat.text: A tricky bounce, Jerry. They'll get another go.

ownAnswerMouse.text: A tough bounce, Jom. Time for a fresh kickoff.

leadAnswerCat.text: One side's out in front. Paws up, Jerry!

leadAnswerMouse.text: The lead changes paws, Jom. Watch the score!
